text:
اعمل Worker تنفيذ كود محدود لدعم دورة new->done فعلياً (لا كتابة معرفة آلية). اقرأ AGENTS/SCHEMA ومرجع المواءمة2026-10-10 وsystems13/14/15/16/config الموجودين. اكتب عبر apply_patch فقط ملفات جديدة ضمن `/sdcard/NEXUS_LLM_WIKI/tools/`: `wiki_workflow.py` و`WORKFLOW_USAGE.md`، واختبارات معنى تحت `tools/tests/test_wiki_workflow.py` وفهرس اختبارات عند الحاجة. سجل تقريرك `/root/r/reports/sales-proof/agent-workflow-runtime.md`. لا تعدّل أي ملفات schema/config/docs خارجها ولا تغيّر raw أو knowledge أو حالة المجالات. لا subagents ولا codex.
الغرض محرك محدود stdlib قابل للتشغيل: inventory لجذور new وraw/new وسجلات sources الحالية دون تصنيف كلمات ولا extraction، read-only JSON status/check لحالة القفل، validate-batch على batch موثق كتبه Agent، publish يضع verified copies وREF metadata وفهارس تحت done/<domain>/<subdomain>/ مع --apply صريح، افتراض dry-run بلا أي كتابة حتى mkdir. لا auto classification ولا fake completeness. الأوامر والschema تُشرح في usage مبكراً ثم اكتب تقرير بنتيجة. batch scope=batch دائماً لا يمثل domain كله. يحتوي batch_id/domain/readers/items وitems(source_id, source_path, sha256, semantic_read with contiguous Unicode char ranges 0..len(raw text) including segment summaries + exact evidence slice لكل segment, primary_route, secondary refs evidence, route_review reviewer/decision/report_ref, terms candidates with exact provenance, claims candidates with evidence_start/end/quote/excerpt_sha256/scope/type/confidence/what_it_does_not_prove). validation verifies raw bytes/content hash and every slice, full range no gaps/overlaps, safe field types/id uniqueness, registered source identity read, routes exist catalog, candidate extraction only current_domain while routing any pending permitted, no source_done/domain_done claimed by batch. SHA/EOF alone cannot certify semantics state clearly; this is supplied Agent review evidence checked mechanically.
publish requires independent route reviewer (reader!=reviewer)+existing review report and all validation pass; create independent byte copies (not hard/symlinks), x/exclusive no overwrite original/new/raw, preserve existing INDEX content with uniquely delimited block or append new entry; if already exact same batch/source/hash paths reuse, no double rows. Existing artifact different or copy symlink/hardlink/wrong hash/path escapes collision -> fail closed before any writes; ensure source hash recheck before copy. Duplicate content on new path references canonical (never new knowledge), names safely source_id.ext deterministic handles Arabic/spaces; avoid unrestricted scan '/' . No deletion/rename/move of originals or test fixtures. Partial publication cannot claim success; errors captured restart resumable. No arbitrary user paths to overwrite config: output files creation only allowed workflow dirs under wiki; raw inventory readonly.
Implement check command that reports domain T false unless snapshot file actual with scope_kind=domain_snapshot, current hash set/inventory matches all declared candidates, all subdomain coverage/evidence/review refs and QA; conservative block absent data. Don't implement full state transition automation if unwarranted: status must enforce only one current_domain and gate/master permission must fail closed on missing/full corpus/semantics/stale/delta. Support --action extract/master to check with --domain (or similar documented), pending extraction fail, routing pending pass. Tool should NEVER mark gates passed from hash or batch.
Tests must catch actual hazards: dry-run no files, verified copy independent+idempotence, same-name changed hash collision, path traversal/symlink/hardlink, false full-read coverage, evidence mismatch, candidate extraction into pending, subset batch never T/master, stale/new-source invalidates readiness. Use stdlib unittest; fixtures under pre-approved /tmp/omnirush with parent ls and no cleanup deletions. Limit pragmatic code, no install needed. Run meaningful tests and LSP. Do not publish real files yet (another Agent will supply batch after schema stable). Return CLI commands and schema path plus limitations. If tasks too large choose safe route/validation implementation complete before optional closure automation; do not implement fake pass stub.
